capabilities.name: Evolution Packet data model
capabilities.evidence: Unit tests construct evidence, hypotheses, mutations, replay results, and packets.
capabilities.limitation: Decision Capsule and Outcome Receipt are currently free-form strings.

capabilities.name: Promotion gate from replay evidence
capabilities.evidence: Unit tests verify positive delta + zero regressions + zero risk flags.
capabilities.limitation: The default gate is intentionally simple and does not weight evidence confidence.

capabilities.name: Behavior PR Markdown renderer
capabilities.evidence: CLI smoke test renders examples/evolution_pr.json into reviewable Markdown.
capabilities.limitation: It renders a review artifact; it does not yet open a GitHub pull request automatically.

capabilities.name: Root GitHub Action for Regression Witness + Proof Integrity
capabilities.evidence: The repository root action is the low-friction PR proof path; init-github generates workflows against it, while the advanced causal Behavior Proof action remains available under actions/behavior-proof.
capabilities.limitation: The Action proves configured test behavior and evidence integrity; it does not autonomously approve, merge, or deploy the pull request.

capabilities.name: Proof Integrity Guard for changed tests and CI
capabilities.evidence: Counterproof deterministically flags deleted tests, added skip/xfail markers, shell failure masking, continue-on-error, removed pull-request workflow triggers, and other evidence-surface changes.
capabilities.limitation: A finding means the judging machinery changed and needs review; it is not proof that the change is malicious or incorrect.

capabilities.name: Install-level real-git doctor self-test
capabilities.evidence: counterproof doctor creates a temporary real Git repository and exercises structured-result parsing, Regression Witness, and Proof Integrity without relying on an external service.
capabilities.limitation: Doctor validates Counterproof's local mechanics, not the consuming repository's project-specific dependency graph or test semantics.

capabilities.name: One-command GitHub onboarding with test-runner detection
capabilities.evidence: counterproof init-github detects common test runners and writes a pull-request workflow wired to Regression Witness and Proof Integrity without overwriting existing config by default.
capabilities.limitation: Project dependency installation is repository-specific and remains the consuming repository's responsibility.

capabilities.name: Regression Witness for agent pull requests
capabilities.evidence: Counterproof detects changed tests, runs them on PR head, overlays the same tests onto a detached base worktree, and distinguishes witnessed fixes from tests that already passed before the change.
capabilities.limitation: The first release relies on repository-local test commands and changed-test filename patterns; dependency setup remains the consuming repository's responsibility.

capabilities.name: Reproducible Proof Receipt with source fingerprints
capabilities.evidence: Counterproof can hash the exact trace and experiment manifest, record observed/expected signatures and selection results, then verify later that the proof still points to unchanged inputs.
capabilities.limitation: The receipt fingerprints source artifacts; it does not yet capture a full container image, dependency lock or external service state.

capabilities.name: Clean wheel install and packaged playground
capabilities.evidence: CI builds a wheel, installs it in a fresh virtualenv, runs the CLI, and serves the packaged frontend.
capabilities.limitation: This proves packaging and startup, not compatibility with every third-party agent stack.

capabilities.name: Deterministic baseline/candidate command replay
capabilities.evidence: CI executes real subprocess pairs from examples/replay_suite.json and checks outcomes.
capabilities.limitation: It is command-based replay, not yet a captured world-state/time-travel runtime.

capabilities.name: Falsifiable probe contracts per hypothesis
capabilities.evidence: Trace compilation emits intervention, expected result, falsifier, and holdout guidance for each ranked hypothesis.
capabilities.limitation: Probe text is deterministic guidance; only attached replay results provide executable evidence.

capabilities.name: Multiple mutation surfaces
capabilities.evidence: The data model accepts skill, prompt, policy, router, memory, tool, and eval surfaces.
capabilities.limitation: Counterproof does not yet apply each mutation surface to a live agent automatically.

capabilities.name: Evidence types and confidence
capabilities.evidence: Evidence kind/verdict/confidence are represented and confidence bounds are validated.
capabilities.limitation: Different evidence kinds are not yet assigned calibrated weights in causal selection.

capabilities.name: Rollback reference and activation scope
capabilities.evidence: Mutation objects store and render rollback_ref and activation_scope.
capabilities.limitation: No runtime rollback executor or activation enforcer exists yet.

capabilities.name: Interactive causal playground
capabilities.evidence: site/ supports hypothesis selection, branch visualization, replay display, promote/rollback state.
capabilities.limitation: Browser replay values are demo fixtures; Promote/Rollback only change local UI state.

capabilities.name: Generic JSON / JSONL trace ingestion
capabilities.evidence: CI compiles raw decision/outcome traces into Evolution Packets with evidence and provenance.
capabilities.limitation: Live GitHub, agent-framework, and observability adapters are not implemented yet.

capabilities.name: Trace -> measured replay -> Behavior Proof
capabilities.evidence: The prove CLI compiles a trace, selects a candidate, executes real replay commands, and renders the report.
capabilities.limitation: Selection is heuristic unless the user explicitly supplies a mutation surface.

capabilities.name: Pre-registered PASS / FAIL predictions for intervention cases
capabilities.evidence: Experiment manifests can register expected outcomes before execution; contradicted or partial predictions are tracked separately from runtime pass/fail and can block automatic selection.
capabilities.limitation: Prediction quality still depends on the experiment author or adapter; Counterproof does not yet learn calibrated causal predictions.

capabilities.name: Active discrimination across competing interventions
capabilities.evidence: The discriminate CLI runs the same baseline cases across multiple mutation surfaces and reports survivors, falsified variants, or ambiguity.
capabilities.limitation: It only discriminates among supplied executable interventions; it does not discover arbitrary interventions automatically.

capabilities.name: Fitness vs diagnostic case-role semantics
capabilities.evidence: Diagnostic cases may intentionally pre-register FAIL outcomes; they contribute to prediction testing but are excluded from fitness failure/regression counting and cannot alone promote a mutation.
capabilities.limitation: Case roles are declared by the experiment author or scaffold generator; domain correctness still depends on the adapter and review.

capabilities.name: Reviewed draft scaffold -> ready adapter binding
capabilities.evidence: The bind-probe-adapter CLI requires a draft scaffold, non-placeholder adapter argv, reviewer identity, and review note before changing status to ready.
capabilities.limitation: Binding authorizes execution plumbing; it does not certify that the adapter faithfully models target-domain semantics.

capabilities.name: Structured json-v1 Probe Result protocol
capabilities.evidence: Adapters can separate process execution from behavioral verdict and emit continuous 0-1 scores, metrics, observations and artifact references via COUNTERPROOF_RESULT JSON.
capabilities.limitation: The protocol records adapter-reported evidence; semantic trust still depends on the adapter, experiment design and review.

capabilities.name: Reusable env-driven Probe Adapter protocol
capabilities.evidence: A single adapter argv can execute baseline and multiple intervention variants using COUNTERPROOF_CASE_ID, COUNTERPROOF_VARIANT and COUNTERPROOF_CASE_JSON across many cases.
capabilities.limitation: Projects still need to implement an adapter that maps those inputs into their own agent or simulator.

capabilities.name: Guarded draft experiment scaffold generation
capabilities.evidence: Ambiguous survivor pairs can be compiled into crossed two-case experiment scaffolds with pre-registered predictions and a shared adapter placeholder.
capabilities.limitation: Generated scaffolds are intentionally status=draft and cannot execute until a human or adapter reviews the assumptions and marks them ready.

capabilities.name: Next discriminating probe planning for ambiguous survivors
capabilities.evidence: When survivor behavior signatures are identical, Counterproof emits a pairwise plan stating what to hold fixed, what levers to vary, competing predictions, and a falsification rule.
capabilities.limitation: The planner produces experiment-design guidance, not an automatically instantiated executable domain test.

capabilities.name: Trace -> multi-intervention discrimination -> guarded selection
capabilities.evidence: The evolve CLI compiles a raw trace, runs competing executable interventions on the same cases, selects only a unique survivor, and leaves ambiguous runs unselected.
capabilities.limitation: Candidate interventions still need executable commands supplied by the experiment manifest.

capabilities.name: Heuristic causal hypothesis proposals
capabilities.evidence: Deterministic rules rank candidate mutation surfaces from trace state, corrections, guards, and explicit hints.
capabilities.limitation: This is not learned causal inference and does not prove a unique root cause.

capabilities.name: Live PR / review / CI / framework trace adapters
capabilities.evidence: Roadmap only.
capabilities.limitation: Current ingestion starts from exported JSON or JSONL traces.

capabilities.name: Captured counterfactual world forks
capabilities.evidence: Roadmap only.
capabilities.limitation: Command replay can compare executions, but does not snapshot and restore arbitrary worlds.

capabilities.name: Automatic mutation PR open / merge / revert
capabilities.evidence: Roadmap only. PR proof comments and CI gates exist, but mutation lifecycle automation does not.
capabilities.limitation: Counterproof does not yet open, merge, deploy, or revert agent mutations automatically.

capabilities.name: Shadow / canary / automatic rollback
capabilities.evidence: Roadmap only.
capabilities.limitation: No online traffic router is implemented.
